cases.request: Stage Rowan on the screen-left side of the stone plinth and Ivo on its screen-right side. Keep both roots in place throughout the cues. At the first cue, Rowan gives a soft wave; at the second, Ivo gives a clear nod. At the third cue, Rowan is neutral, softly. Each cue begins at its numbered slot, with two seconds per slot.

For the blue marker, put Sol on screen-left and Mica on screen-right. Do not move either actor's root. At cue 0, Mica nods clearly; at cue 1, Sol waves clearly. At cue 2, Mica is neutral with soft variation. The numbered cue slots are two seconds apart in duration.

Place Kite to the screen-right of the archive stand and North to its screen-left. Keep their roots stationary. North should nod clearly in slot 0; Kite should wave softly in slot 1; and Kite should be neutral with soft variation in slot 2. Each slot lasts two seconds. Nod comes before the wave.

At the floor compass, put Elm on screen-right and Rill on screen-left. Keep both actors planted without root travel. Make the whole sequence quiet: Elm gives a soft wave in slot 0, Rill gives a soft nod in slot 1, and Rill is neutral with soft variation in slot 2. Every slot lasts two seconds.
